## The problem

What is hard, missing or awkward today? A problem statement helps more than a
solution - it lets us disagree about the fix.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen.

## Who is it for

- [ ] New creators (onboarding -> first video)
- [ ] Returning creators (daily idea loop)
- [ ] Creators editing or refining their DNA
- [ ] Developers building on the API

## Alternatives considered

Anything else you tried or rejected.

## Scope hint

- [ ] Web UI only
- [ ] API + worker (render pipeline, learning loop)
- [ ] New prompt template (`packages/prompts`)
- [ ] Deployment / infra
- [ ] Docs only
